confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee, beer, cocktail and wine anchors are bounded from travel blogs and cost-of-living sites that disagree on exact figures, so they are rough. Meal anchors are the better-supported group. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge for July peak season; no booking pages or current listings were checked. The RBA observation returned by search is from 2026-03-20, about eight months before the generation date, so it may not be the latest published rate.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is Rome's own typical tourist-zone price levels for food and drink, cross-checked against other major Italian and Western European capital tourist cities. Accommodation is a model estimate for Rome in July peak season.
